title: QuickHome
description: A lightweight Paper plugin that lets players set and teleport to up to three homes, keeping navigation simple and balanced.
body:
## Overview

This is a lightweight and efficient Paper plugin that allows players to set, manage, and teleport to up to three home locations. It is designed with simplicity and performance in mind, making it a perfect addition to servers that want essential /sethome functionality without unnecessary complexity.

## Features

* Set up to **3 homes per player**
* Simple and intuitive commands
* Fast and reliable teleportation
* Optimized specifically for **Paper servers**
* Lightweight with minimal performance impact
* Basic permission support for easy control

## Why Choose This Plugin?

Unlike larger, feature-heavy plugins, this plugin focuses on doing one thing well: providing a clean and balanced home system. Limiting players to three homes helps maintain fair gameplay while still giving enough flexibility for exploration and base management.

## Usage

Players can quickly set and return to their homes using simple commands, making navigation across the world much easier and more convenient.

## Compatibility

Built specifically for **Paper**, ensuring maximum performance and stability.

---

Perfect for survival, SMP, and community servers that want a straightforward and reliable sethome system.
